    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    man_patches = image_patch.find("man")
    glasses_patches = image_patch.find("glasses")
    
    if not man_patches or not glasses_patches:
        return image_patch
    
    man_centers = [(p.left + p.right) / 2 for p in man_patches]
    glasses_centers = [(p.left + p.right) / 2 for p in glasses_patches]

def find_top_right_lady(image):
    # Create an ImagePatch object
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)

    # Find all patches of "lady"
    lady_patches = image_patch.find("lady")

    # If no "lady" found, return None
    if not lady_patches:
        return None

    # Sort the patches by their upper-right corner coordinates
    lady_patches.sort(key=lambda patch: (patch.upper, -patch.right))

    # Return the patch with the highest upper-right corner coordinate
    return lady_patches[-1]

modern_c2_q7.program:
def execute_command(image) -> ImagePatch:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    vest_patches = image_patch.find("vest")
    hat_patches = image_patch.find("hat")

    if not vest_patches or not hat_patches:
        return image_patch

    vest_depths = [p.compute_depth() for p in vest_patches]
    hat_depths = [p.compute_depth() for p in hat_patches]

    vest_median_depth = sorted(vest_depths)[len(vest_depths) // 2]
    hat_median_depth = sorted(hat_depths)[len(hat_depths) // 2]

    closest_vest = min(vest_patches, key=lambda v: abs(v.compute_depth() - hat_median_depth))
    closest_hat = min(hat_patches, key=lambda h: abs(h.compute_depth() - vest_median_depth))

    if closest_vest.vertical_center < closest_hat.vertical_center:
        return closest_vest
    else:
        return closest_hat
